adopt: Drive one page and get back what is on it in a form worth reasoning about.
description:
Kind: tool

Problem
Handing an agent a screenshot makes it read a picture of text; handing it raw DOM makes it read a megabyte of markup. Neither of those is the page.

Install
pip install awbrowse

Commands
  awbrowse

Quick start
  pip install awbrowse

Docs
https://aitherium.github.io/awbrowse/
